# Minion Lucky damage (Queer Angle)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, lucky

## Derived / confirmed formula

A minion damage type with minion_lucky_<type> active rolls its range twice, keeping the higher -> EV = min + 2/3 x range (vs midpoint). Only affects types with a min/max spread (base hit has none). Mirrors the player _luck_ratio.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified. Minions with no damage spread see no Lucky benefit (correct).

mod_parser: 'You and Minions deal Lucky Damage' -> player lucky_<type> + minion_lucky_<type> (condition clause split off, e.g. enemy_numbed). minion_offense applies the Lucky per-type average.
